full_prompt_en: The image is a square decorative digital painting of a pale side profile integrated with patterned geometric panels. A woman faces right at close range, her smooth ivory face occupying the central-right part of the frame. Her straight nose, lightly closed lips, and downcast eye are modeled with gentle warm shadows rather than strong outlines. A muted terracotta head covering curves over her hair from the upper left, bordered by a dark gray-green band that falls beside her cheek. The head and neck are cropped at the lower edge, where layered dark olive, rust, and black shapes suggest clothing. Behind and around her, the picture is divided into a grid of narrow rectangles, squares, and diagonal wedges. At the upper left, a large brown circular fan or dial lies partly behind the profile. Vertical ochre blocks with tiny inset marks sit near the center, while dark teal and brown panels on the right carry subtle floral and curling relief patterns. Smaller textured tiles fill the lower right; a few broad diagonal sections cross the lower left. The foreground profile remains softly rounded against these flatter architectural-looking color planes. Light seems to come from the front-right, brightening the forehead, cheek, and bridge of the nose while leaving the covering and surrounding panels in subdued shadow. The palette is restrained to ivory, terracotta, warm brown, ochre, muted teal, and olive, with no bright white or saturated accent. Fine grain and engraved-looking ornament keep the flat blocks tactile. The composition balances one quiet continuous contour against a dense patchwork of rectangular and circular motifs, creating a still, icon-like presence.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形装饰性数字绘画：一张浅色侧脸嵌入有纹样的几何拼接中。女子在近处朝右，平滑象牙色面孔占据中央偏右区域。她挺直的鼻、轻轻合上的唇与低垂的眼用柔和暖影塑形，而非浓重勾线。低饱和陶土红头巾从左上弯过头发，边沿一道深灰绿色带沿脸颊垂下。头和颈在下画边被裁去，那里叠着深橄榄、锈红与黑色形块，暗示衣装。她身后及周围，画面被切成窄矩形、方块与斜楔组成的网格。左上方一个大棕色圆扇或圆盘部分藏在侧脸后。中央附近的竖赭色块有细小嵌入记号，右侧深青与棕色面板带隐约花草卷曲浮纹。更小的纹理方砖填在右下；左下交过几块宽斜面。前景侧影在这些较平的建筑般色面前保持柔和圆润。光似乎从右前方来，照亮前额、脸颊与鼻梁，头巾和周围面板留在收敛阴影里。色盘限定为象牙、陶土红、暖棕、赭、低饱和青色与橄榄，没有刺白或饱和点缀。细颗粒和刻纹般装饰让平色块可触。构图让一条安静连续的轮廓与密集的矩形、圆形纹样拼接保持平衡，带来静止而像圣像的存在感。
style_prompt_en: Decorative digital painting places softly modeled ivory curves inside a dense modular grid of muted terracotta, ochre, olive, brown, and dark teal. Narrow rectangles, square insets, diagonal wedges, and partial circular arcs overlap with careful alignment. One continuous pale contour moves through flatter patterned blocks, creating contrast between sculpted volume and tiled geometry. Fine grain, etched scrollwork, and low-relief motifs texture the colored planes without making them noisy. Warm frontal light concentrates on the pale focal shape, while surrounding modules hold subdued shadow. Edges are precise but slightly softened by painterly shading. The arrangement feels still and icon-like, with intricate ornament and a tightly controlled earth-color range.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性数字绘画把柔和塑形的象牙色曲面放进由低饱和陶土红、赭、橄榄、棕与深青色组成的密集模块网格。窄矩形、方形嵌块、斜楔与局部圆弧精确对齐并互相覆盖。一条连续浅色轮廓穿过较平的纹样色块，使雕塑感体积与拼砖式几何相对。细颗粒、刻纹卷草与浅浮纹给有色平面添肌理，又不让它们嘈杂。暖色正面光集中在浅色焦点形状，周围模块维持收敛阴影。边缘准确，却被绘画式明暗稍稍柔化。布局静止而像圣像，带繁密装饰与严格受控的土色范围。
theme_en: A pale side profile integrated with patterned geometric panels
theme_zh: 一张浅色侧脸嵌入有纹样的几何拼接中
name: George Underwood
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
